Plot benchmark examples

Source: R/utils.R
plot_L0glm_benchmark.Rd

Function to plot the comparison between the fitted model and the known true model. It used in the L0glm examples and should not be expected to useful in another use.

Usage

plot_L0glm_benchmark(x, y, coefs, fitted, inference = NULL, a.true, ...)

Arguments

x

a vector of length n with time labels.

y

a vector of length n with signal.

coefs

XXX

fitted

XXX

inference

the output of L0glm.inference

a.true

the true coefficients

...

further arguments passed to plot

Value

The function returns NULL, but plots y with the expected coefficients and the fitted values from fit with the estimated coefficients in a way that gives an intuitive view on the quality of the fit.
